Q: When does a LangChain abstraction need to be replaced with a smaller explicit boundary?
spoken: Use an abstraction while it makes the required data flow, retries, callbacks and authority observable. If hidden behavior makes lifecycle or error handling ambiguous, inspect and configure it or isolate a smaller explicit adapter. Do not let a convenience wrapper own business authorization simply because it already calls the model.

Use an abstraction while it makes the required data flow, retries, callbacks and authority observable. Boundary defense: No. The receiver’s commit and deduplication contract remain application concerns across every framework.
